items.title: Tesla deploys 13.5 GWh of storage in Q2 2026
items.summary: Tesla's global energy storage deployments rose 53% quarter-over-quarter, its second-largest quarterly total on record. The company holds its Q2 earnings call on July 22.

items.title: BNEF raises 2026 global storage forecast to 158GW/459GWh
items.summary: BloombergNEF's H1 2026 outlook counted 112GW/307GWh added in 2025 and expects annual additions to nearly double over the next decade, reaching 308GW by 2036.

items.title: Alpiq to acquire 90% of UK developer Harmony Energy
items.summary: The Swiss power firm's acquisition consolidates its position in the UK battery storage development and operations market.

items.title: China holds 76% of global BESS integrator market share
items.summary: Chinese system integrators cemented their dominance of the global battery storage market in 2025, even as S&P Global expects Chinese installations to soften in 2026 following the removal of a solar-pairing mandate.

items.title: Sodium-ion storage gains ground in the US and Europe
items.summary: Peak Energy, ESS Tech, and Unigrid each announced advances in sodium-ion storage technology, positioning the chemistry as a lower-cost, lithium-free alternative for stationary storage.

items.title: HyperStrong to launch sodium-ion BESS in China first
items.summary: The system integrator plans to bring sodium-ion products to its home market before expanding internationally, per its technology president.

items.title: Elestor deploys large hydrogen-iron flow battery in the Netherlands
items.summary: A 20MW/200-800MWh hydrogen-iron flow battery system is being installed at Windpark Zeewolde, described as Europe's largest onshore wind farm, in partnership with Dutch LDES developer Elestor.

items.title: Eni and L-H Battery expand cell manufacturing capacity
items.summary: Eni Storage Systems broke ground on an LFP-cell gigafactory in Italy, while L-H Battery Company began lithium-ion cell production at its Jeffersonville, Ohio plant this month.

items.title: OBBBA reshapes US storage tax credit landscape
items.summary: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act restructured IRA incentives; battery storage retained technology-neutral credits (45Y/48E) through 2032, though FEOC sourcing compliance and a July 2026 safe-harbor deadline require near-term developer attention.

items.title: DOE pushes FERC to take over large-load interconnection rules
items.summary: The Department of Energy asked FERC in late 2025 to assert jurisdiction over large-load interconnection standards, targeting an April 2026 rule, partly to unclog queues jammed by data-center demand that storage projects also depend on.

items.title: States move on new BESS fire-safety requirements
items.summary: Following fires at battery storage facilities, state policymakers and regulators are developing new safety standards that could add near-term cost and permitting delays before settling into standard practice.

items.title: Vietnam adopts two-part BESS tariff structure
items.summary: Circular 62/2025/TT-BCT made Vietnam the first major ASEAN economy to pay storage for both availability and delivery, a shift seen as a model for the wider region's regulatory frameworks.
